title: Chapter 679 - 679 The Door; Broken!

Chapter 679 - 679 The Door; Broken!

Chapter 679 - 679 The Door; Broken!

679 The Door; Broken!

Even though Lin Fan already knew how to stop the destruction of the world, he could not think of a way to improve his Time Control Technique.

After all, time was very mysterious and complicated.

In his previous life, when Lin Fan was still a Chaos Dragon God, he had only managed to comprehend a tiny bit of the Time Control Technique.

However, after so many years, there was no improvement.

To improve quickly was easier said than done.

…

In the blink of an eye, two months had passed.

Sometimes, the more urgent the matter, the more difficult it was to handle.

It was like that for Lin Fan.

In these two months, Lin Fan had practically spent all of his time in seclusion. However, there was not much of an effect.

On this day…

When Lin Xiaoyao walked over, Lin Fan opened his eyes.

“Brother, do you want to have dinner together today?” Lin Xiaoyao asked.

Lin Fan nodded. “Alright.”

In the past two months, he rarely had time to accompany his family.

Since he was unable to grasp a deeper level of time control, it was good to spend more time with his family.

“Really?” Lin Xiaoyao said happily. “I’ll tell my sisters-in-law now!”

Hence, the entire Coiling Dragon Villa quickly became lively.

Smoke rose, and the fragrance filled the air.

Not long after, the table was filled with all kinds of dishes. They looked, smelled, and tasted delicious. One could not help but swallow when one smelled the food.

“Lin Fan, come, have some beef.”

“This is the pork ribs I cooked!”

“I steamed the fish.”

“This is the lobster I prepared.”

…

Lin Fan’s plate was soon filled with all sorts of dishes.

He could not help but laugh. “If you guys give me more food, my plate won’t be able to hold it all.”

When everyone heard this, they stopped.

At this moment, Lin Xiaoyao suddenly shouted excitedly, “Wow! It’s snowing!”

Everyone looked out of the tall French windows.

Snowflakes that looked like goose feathers slowly drifted down from the sky.

“So beautiful!” Hu Tian praised.

“It’s been a long time since I’ve seen such heavy snow,” Han Tian said.

It was very heartwarming to watch the snow while eating.

Lin Fan was also looking at the snow.

He looked at the snow quietly and seemed to have caught something.

However, there seemed to be something missing. He could not figure it out at the moment.

It was New Year’s Eve.

Lin Fan’s family maintained the customs from a thousand years ago. They had New Year’s Eve dinner, set off firecrackers, and fireworks…

It was noisy, gorgeous, and filled with laughter.

“So beautiful!” Su Ning said quietly.

“As expected, we still have to set off fireworks during the new year!” Song Jiaxin said.

“This is good, this is good!” Huang Ling said.

“Light up the sky lanterns!” Lin Xiaoyao said.

As she spoke, she lit up a lantern.

Then, the lantern began to rise.

“It’s flying!” Lin Xiaoyao shouted excitedly. “It flew! I have to make a wish.”

As she spoke, she put her palms together and silently said something.

With Lin Fan’s strength, not to mention letting a small lantern fly up into the sky, even a castle would not be a problem.

However, at this moment, he also raised his head and looked at the lantern silently. He was very focused and curious.

A cold wind blew.

Then, a large amount of snowflakes fell.

“It’s snowing!” Lin Xiaoyao shouted excitedly. “It’s snowing again!”

As she spoke, she spun around in circles. She was very happy.

Lin Fan’s eyes lit up.

In the next moment, all the snow in the sky seemed to be attracted by something as they flew toward Lin Fan and revolved around him. It was extremely mysterious.

Seeing this…

Lin Xiaoyao, Xia Xue, Xia Bing, Hu Tian, Han Tian, and the others did not disturb them.

That was because they knew that Lin Fan had been cultivating hard recently.

Now, perhaps he had discovered something.

They consciously retreated to a very far position and looked at the huge snowball that was hundreds of thousands of meters tall from afar.

The sun rose, and the moon set.

This huge snowball had been standing in the Coiling Dragon Villa all this time. It did not change at all with the change of the weather.

In the blink of an eye, it was the 15th day of the first lunar month.

Lin Xiaoyao, who was wearing a down jacket, said worriedly, “Is my brother alright?”

Xia Xue and Xia Bing said in unison, “He’s fine.”

Hu Tian, Song Jiaxin, Huang Ling, Qiu Ziqian, and the others did not speak.

However, from the determination in their beautiful eyes, they clearly agreed with Xia Xue and Xia Bing.

At this moment, the huge snowball suddenly shrunk.

Meanwhile, snowflakes suddenly fell from the sky.

Furthermore, the snowflakes were becoming larger and larger as the snowball got smaller.

When the snowball grew bigger again, the snowflakes in the sky suddenly disappeared.

This magical scene shocked everyone present with their mouths wide open.

The huge snowball disappeared completely, and the snowflakes in the sky suddenly became denser.

In the next moment, a tall and handsome figure appeared in front of everyone.

It was Lin Fan.

“Brother!” Lin Xiaoyao shouted.

Xia Xue and Xia Bing said in unison, “Lin Fan!”

“Lin Fan, are you alright?”

“Lin Fan, how are you?”

…

Everyone started asking him questions, their faces full of worry.

Lin Fan smiled. “Don’t worry, I’m fine.”

At this moment, a loud sound came from the void, and the entire world began to tremble violently.

The sea churned, the ground shook violently, and the rocks collapsed!

It was like the end of the world.

Then, cracks appeared in the sky, as if the sky was about to shatter. It was extremely terrifying.

Many people raised their heads, their eyes filled with fear as they discussed.

“What’s going on in the sky?”

“It can’t be that it’s about to break, right?”

“This is too scary!”

…

Lin Fan, who had always been calm, raised his brows.

“You guys rest at home. I’ll be right back!”

As soon as he finished speaking, he took a step forward and disappeared from where he was.

Hearing this, everyone began to pray silently.

They knew that Lin Fan was going to do something big,. It was something that could save the world!

…

Red, green, blue, gray, purple, and black shadows all stood in front of the ancient door.

At this moment, the cracks on the door had already become as dense as a spider web.

They could even see the outside world through these cracks with their naked eye.

When Lin Fan arrived, the gray shadow said, “The door is about to break! Do you have a solution?”

Lin Fan did not reply immediately. Instead, he stared at the door with a burning gaze.

The first time he saw the door, Lin Fan could feel the pressure from it. He felt like an ant.

The second time he saw the door, Lin Fan finally had the ability to look straight at it.

Now, this was the third time Lin Fan was seeing the door. He felt that there was still a gap between him and the creator of the door. However, the gap was small!

“It’s broken!” Lin Fan said.

As if to verify Lin Fan’s words, the ancient door shattered.

The terrifying shards turned into a rain of arrows that filled the sky and flew wildly. It was extremely terrifying.
